requiredPostRebootProof: The WSL boot ID must differ from bootIdBefore.
Docker, Eva1, the active managed Eva2 route and the retained fallback must return without manual container recreation.
Both PostgreSQL databases, both access leases, Hindsight and the core must return without a restart loop.
The active route must answer through Eva1's real /eva2 client and retain its pre-reboot context.
Hindsight counts and the owner dashboard access boundary must remain intact.
Eva1 must answer all five health routes and keep its configured /eva2 route on port 44710.
nonClaims: This pre-reboot record is not itself reboot proof.
No external Telegram message or Home Assistant effect is part of this test.
A Windows hardware reboot and the seven-day practice run remain separate gates.
